purpose: Expected outcomes fixed before blinded controlled-criteria qualification

findings.clean_construct: Validate the report, then emit it.
findings.basis: The protocol explicitly permits unvalidated emission; this independently fails AP-01.

findings.seeded_construct: Retain the report ID; emit the report without validation.
findings.clean_construct: Retain the report ID; validate the report before each emission.
findings.basis: The first retention clause is valid. The independent second clause permits unvalidated emission; evaluating only the first clause misses AP-01.

findings.seeded_construct: initialActivity run; graph run.done resolves to run
findings.clean_construct: initialActivity run; graph run.done resolves to null
findings.basis: Every reachable transition in the seeded workflow returns to run. No finite terminating path exists, although the activity ID resolves.

findings.seeded_construct: Unchanged routine exports emit.report; produce declares only summary
findings.clean_construct: Unchanged routine exports emit.report; produce declares report
findings.basis: The consumer remains byte-identical and outside the explicitly changed paths. Its output binding names an absent producer output under AP-02.

findings.seeded_construct: delivery invokes deliver with packet; deliver requires envelope
findings.clean_construct: delivery invokes deliver with envelope; deliver requires envelope
findings.basis: The invocation has one unknown argument and omits the required one. These two symptoms are one binding defect at the delivery reference site under AP-02.

findings.seeded_construct: Leaf destination public conflicts with inherited destination archive
findings.clean_construct: Leaf destination archive satisfies inherited destination archive
findings.basis: The executing qualification workflow supplies the inherited rule through the delivery and emit call chain. The seeded leaf destination violates DP-01.
